literal_meaning: অমৃতের পথে যাত্রা (journey on the path of nectar or immortality)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার অমৃতপথযাত্রা হয়েছে, আমরা সকলে শোকাহত।
বৃদ্ধের অমৃতপথযাত্রার স্মৃতি আমাদের মনে রয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He has embarked on his journey to the afterlife, leaving us all in grief.
The elder's passage to the immortal path remains etched in our memories.
history: Derived from Hindu mythology where 'amrita' refers to the nectar of immortality, used ironically here to euphemize death as a journey to the divine realm.
note: This idiom poetically contrasts immortality with the finality of death, common in Bengali literary expressions.
